svg.title: AERI subtask loop, one round: set up, forward loop, home, reverse loop
svg.desc: Earlier versions ran on the robot only in external mode, with an agent answering for the vision model; this version and the local vision model have not run on the robot. Set a task name and the number of rounds; the vision model lists the objects and you confirm them. Each round: release in terminal D, the model plans pick-and-place subtasks, the policy runs each for up to 200 steps, the model checks and moves on or retries up to 5 times; the forward loop ends at home, and an s or f you press in D during it labels the round; the reverse loop resets the scene the same way. By default the policy and the model take turns on the GPU. Only terminal D moves the robot; the model's done only moves the flow on, the result is your label.
